src: hollow 4x4 foreground frame sprites s, ignoring solid 4x4 blocks
dst: contiguous output sprite slots d along the hollow-frame dominant axis
match_cond: rank(s by position on the chosen axis) == rank(d)
transform: crop each frame to its bbox and paste the crops edge-to-edge without recoloring
multi_step: choose horizontal packing when frame column span exceeds row span; choose vertical packing when row span exceeds column span
grid_shape: common 4x4 frame crop size multiplied by number of hollow frames along the chosen packing axis
